Aries._note: TODO guidance for Midheaven in Aries: keep the MC sign legible, then let the chart ruler body explain how that vocation or visibility works in practice.
Aries.Sun: With Aries on the Midheaven, visibility asks for initiative rather than permission. When the Sun carries that pathway, the public role becomes strongest when the person leads from authorship, names what they are building, and lets their own vitality set the pace without turning courage into constant self-proving.
Aries.Moon: An Aries Midheaven needs room to respond quickly, but the Moon makes that visibility emotionally legible. The vocation may move through protection, care, instinct, or community need; people recognize the person because they act when something vulnerable requires a first defender.
Aries.Mercury: Aries at the top of the chart gives the public style a decisive edge, and Mercury turns that edge into language. Contribution comes through naming the point, starting the conversation, making the call, or translating urgency into a plan people can understand quickly enough to use.
Aries.Venus: An Aries Midheaven does not wait to be chosen, yet Venus gives its visibility a relational and aesthetic intelligence. The person may become known for bold taste, direct advocacy, creative desire, or the ability to initiate connection without softening their values for approval.
Aries.Mars: With Mars carrying an Aries Midheaven, public life has a visible ignition point. The person is recognized through action, confrontation, entrepreneurship, physical effort, or decisive response; the gift is momentum, while the discipline is learning which battles deserve the full force of their fire.
Aries.Jupiter: An Aries Midheaven with Jupiter as its carrier expands through brave openings. Vocation grows when the person trusts the first step, teaches through example, or makes possibility feel actionable; the risk is promising more movement than the systems behind the promise can actually hold.
Aries.Saturn: Aries visibility becomes more durable when Saturn carries it. The public role may require courage under constraint, leadership earned through consistency, or the patience to build authority one responsible action at a time instead of needing every bold move to prove immediate strength.
Aries.Uranus: An Aries Midheaven carried by Uranus makes the person visible when they interrupt inertia. Their contribution may arrive through innovation, refusal, reform, or the sudden move that shows others a stale rule was never permanent; steadiness comes from choosing which disruptions are worth sustaining.
Aries.Neptune: With Neptune carrying an Aries Midheaven, public action is shaped by vision, sensitivity, and the pull of an image not yet solid. The person may be seen as a dream-starter, spiritual initiator, artist, or advocate, but clarity matters so inspiration does not dissolve into vague crusade.
Aries.Pluto: An Aries Midheaven carried by Pluto makes visibility intense, catalytic, and difficult to fake. The vocation may involve crisis, power, survival, exposure, or transformation; the person becomes publicly effective when they stop performing fearlessness and use their force to change what cannot remain untouched.
Aries.Chiron: With Chiron carrying an Aries Midheaven, the public path often forms around the wound of agency: who was allowed to act, choose, fight, or begin. Vocation becomes medicine when the person models courageous self-direction without demanding that bravery look invulnerable.
Aries.fallback: An Aries Midheaven becomes visible through first motion, direct presence, and the willingness to begin before the path is fully approved. Whatever carries the chart ruler, the public contribution works best when courage is paired with enough self-awareness to choose the right fight.

Leo.Mars: With Mars carrying a Leo Midheaven, public contribution carries heat, courage, and theatrical force. The person may lead through performance, advocacy, competition, or creative risk; the discipline is to act from devotion to the work, not from the need to keep proving they matter.
Leo.Jupiter: A Leo Midheaven carried by Jupiter expands through generosity of presence. The person may become visible by teaching confidence, celebrating talent, gathering an audience, or making meaning feel larger and brighter; the caution is letting grandeur stay connected to honest craft.

Leo.Uranus: A Leo Midheaven carried by Uranus makes visibility electric, unconventional, and hard to script. Capricorn.Saturn: With Saturn carrying a Capricorn Midheaven, the public path is deeply aligned with accountability, time, and durable achievement. Recognition may arrive through mastery, governance, stewardship, or long commitment; the person’s authority becomes real when they can carry responsibility without becoming owned by it.
Capricorn.Uranus: A Capricorn Midheaven carried by Uranus makes the person visible through structural reform. Their contribution may disrupt institutions, redesign authority, modernize systems, or refuse inherited hierarchies; the work succeeds when rebellion becomes architecture rather than only escape.
Capricorn.Neptune: With Neptune carrying a Capricorn Midheaven, vocation blends responsibility with imagination, compassion, and vision. The person may be called to give form to something subtle: art, care, spirituality, or collective longing; clear boundaries keep the dream from being swallowed by obligation.
Capricorn.Pluto: A Capricorn Midheaven carried by Pluto gives public life a profound relationship with authority, legacy, control, and institutional power. The person may be drawn into transformation through leadership, crisis, inheritance, or systems that need exposure; their real influence comes from changing the structure, not merely occupying its top floor.
Capricorn.Chiron: With Chiron carrying a Capricorn Midheaven, the vocation may form around wounds of authority, achievement, parentification, or being valued only for competence. The person becomes visible by teaching responsibility without hardness and ambition without self-abandonment.
Capricorn.fallback: A Capricorn Midheaven becomes visible through responsibility, mastery, structure, and the capacity to build something that lasts. Whatever carries the chart ruler, the public contribution works best when authority remains human, accountable, and connected to purpose rather than mere endurance.

Aquarius.Neptune: With Neptune carrying an Aquarius Midheaven, the public role carries a dream of collective healing, artistic futurism, spiritual community, or compassionate systems. vocational_public_structure.1: Vocational structure becomes visible through presence, initiative, and the way the person enters a room before any formal title explains them. Public participation asks them to embody the work directly, so credibility grows when their manner, body, and first choices match the role they are claiming.
vocational_public_structure.2: Vocational structure becomes visible through value, pricing, materials, and the tangible proof that a contribution can hold weight. The public role is carried by resources: what the person builds, earns, protects, or makes reliable enough for others to trust without constant explanation.
vocational_public_structure.3: Vocational structure becomes visible through language, teaching, writing, local movement, and the daily exchange of information. The public role may form through messages that circulate, skills that translate complex material, or the person’s ability to keep a practical network of contact alive.
vocational_public_structure.4: Vocational structure becomes visible through foundations: home, ancestry, land, family systems, or the private base that makes public work possible. The contribution may look less like performance and more like creating conditions where people, projects, or lineages can actually take root.
vocational_public_structure.5: Vocational structure becomes visible through creative risk, performance, pleasure, children, romance, or the courage to make something personal enough to be recognizable. The public role strengthens when the person treats joy and authorship as real responsibilities, not decorative extras.
vocational_public_structure.6: Vocational structure becomes visible through service, craft, health, maintenance, and the systems that make daily work dependable. The contribution is not only what the person announces, but what they repeat well enough that others can count on the process behind the promise.
vocational_public_structure.7: Vocational structure becomes visible through clients, collaborators, contracts, and one-to-one accountability. The public role is shaped by the people who meet the person as an equal, so partnership becomes the arena where professional standards, boundaries, and reputation are tested in real time.
vocational_public_structure.8: Vocational structure becomes visible through trust, shared resources, crisis work, intimacy, and the parts of public life that require discretion. The contribution may involve handling what others cannot manage alone: inheritance, debt, grief, power, dependency, or the consequences hidden beneath the surface.
vocational_public_structure.9: Vocational structure becomes visible through belief, education, publishing, travel, law, or the search for a larger frame. The public role grows when the person can turn lived experience into perspective, teaching, advocacy, or a map that helps others orient beyond familiar territory.
vocational_public_structure.10: Vocational structure becomes visible through reputation, authority, leadership, and the formal role others recognize. This placement makes the public dimension unmistakable: the person’s contribution is judged by consistency, consequence, and whether the work can stand when it is seen from a distance.
vocational_public_structure.11: Vocational structure becomes visible through networks, audiences, friends, communities, and collective aims. The public role may not belong to a single institution; it forms through the people who gather around a future, cause, platform, or shared experiment the person helps organize.
vocational_public_structure.12: Vocational structure becomes visible through hidden labor, spiritual service, retreat, institutions, endings, and the quiet work no one claps for immediately. The contribution may operate behind the curtain, but it still shapes the field by tending what would otherwise remain neglected or unnamed.
vocational_public_structure.fallback: Vocational structure becomes visible through the life area asked to carry public responsibility. The contribution is not only a job title; it is the place where skill, consequence, and participation become recognizable enough for others to respond to.

relational_structure.1: Relational structure becomes visible through presence, self-definition, and the way the person meets others before any agreement is spoken. Partnership works best when identity is not abandoned at the door; the public pattern begins with how clearly the person can arrive as themselves.
relational_structure.2: Relational structure becomes visible through values, money, possessions, and the terms of exchange. The relationship pattern asks what is worth protecting, what can be shared, and whether reciprocity is grounded in real capacity rather than politeness, projection, or unspoken debt.
relational_structure.3: Relational structure becomes visible through conversation, siblings, neighbors, messages, and the daily language of contact. Agreements are shaped less by grand declarations than by how people explain themselves, correct misunderstandings, keep each other informed, and remain reachable in ordinary time.
relational_structure.4: Relational structure becomes visible through home, family memory, ancestry, and the emotional architecture beneath connection. The public face of relationship may be private at its source: who belongs, what safety requires, and which inherited patterns are being repeated, repaired, or refused.
relational_structure.5: Relational structure becomes visible through pleasure, romance, creativity, play, and the willingness to be openly delighted. Connection is tested by more than loyalty; it is also revealed by whether joy, desire, attention, and creative self-expression can move without becoming performance or possession.
relational_structure.6: Relational structure becomes visible through care, labor, health, schedules, and the small tasks that reveal who actually shows up. The pattern is carried by maintenance: how people divide responsibility, notice strain, make room for bodies, and respect the work connection requires.
relational_structure.7: Relational structure becomes visible through partnership itself: marriage, clients, collaborators, opponents, and chosen equals. This house makes the theme direct, so the central question is whether agreements are mutual enough to hold honesty, difference, negotiation, and real accountability.
relational_structure.8: Relational structure becomes visible through intimacy, shared resources, secrecy, grief, trust, and the places where lives become entangled. The relationship pattern asks who can be close without taking over, who can receive help without surrendering agency, and what power is being exchanged.
relational_structure.9: Relational structure becomes visible through belief, distance, culture, study, and the larger meanings people bring into connection. Relationships may be shaped by different worlds meeting, so the work is not sameness; it is building enough respect for truth, travel, learning, and conviction to coexist.
relational_structure.10: Relational structure becomes visible through public roles, reputation, status, and the responsibilities others can see. Partnership may become part of a public architecture: who stands beside whom, who carries which role, and whether private agreements can survive visibility, pressure, or ambition.
relational_structure.11: Relational structure becomes visible through friendships, communities, audiences, and shared futures. The pattern asks how connection behaves in a wider field, where loyalty is not only personal attachment but participation in networks, causes, mutual aid, and the people who witness becoming.
relational_structure.12: Relational structure becomes visible through privacy, absence, dreams, institutions, and unconscious patterns that shape connection before anyone names them. Relationships may require solitude, compassion, or quiet truth-telling about what has been hidden, sacrificed, idealized, or carried without credit.
relational_structure.fallback: Relational structure becomes visible through the house that receives the bond’s real consequences. The theme asks where reciprocity, agreement, desire, obligation, and repair become concrete enough to change how people participate with one another.

inner_life_restoration_structure.1: Inner life restoration becomes visible through presence, embodiment, and the way the person returns to themselves in public view. The repair is not hidden from the world; it shows in posture, pacing, and the choice to move from a less defended self.
inner_life_restoration_structure.2: Inner life restoration becomes visible through money, appetite, possessions, and the daily experience of having enough. The public pattern asks whether safety can be made material: a steadier budget, a nourished body, a protected tool, or a value system that no longer bargains against itself.
inner_life_restoration_structure.3: Inner life restoration becomes visible through language, local movement, siblings, neighbors, and the texture of ordinary conversation. Healing becomes structural when the person changes how they name their needs, how they receive information, and which daily contacts are allowed to shape their nervous system.
inner_life_restoration_structure.4: Inner life restoration becomes visible through home, ancestry, family memory, and the private base beneath the life. This house carries the theme directly: the public consequence begins with a room, lineage, boundary, or emotional foundation that finally supports rather than extracts.
inner_life_restoration_structure.5: Inner life restoration becomes visible through play, romance, creativity, and the willingness to feel alive without justifying it. Repair may arrive through expression that is not useful first: making something, desiring openly, laughing again, or letting joy become part of the structure.
inner_life_restoration_structure.6: Inner life restoration becomes visible through routines, health, labor, and the small repeated acts that train the body to believe life is livable. The theme becomes concrete through calendars, meals, sleep, care tasks, and work patterns that stop treating depletion as proof of devotion.
inner_life_restoration_structure.7: Inner life restoration becomes visible through partnership, equal exchange, and the people who mirror the person back to themselves. The repair is tested in agreement: whether closeness can include boundaries, whether support can be received, and whether old relational reflexes still get to govern the room.
inner_life_restoration_structure.8: Inner life restoration becomes visible through intimacy, shared resources, grief, trust, and what the person can no longer keep buried. This house makes repair less cosmetic and more consequential: something private changes how power, debt, vulnerability, or inheritance is handled.
inner_life_restoration_structure.9: Inner life restoration becomes visible through belief, study, travel, teachers, and the larger story the person uses to orient themselves. Healing may require a new cosmology: not a prettier explanation, but a framework spacious enough to hold what happened without making it the whole map.
inner_life_restoration_structure.10: Inner life restoration becomes visible through public responsibility, reputation, career, and the role others ask the person to hold. The private work becomes part of the outer architecture when authority is no longer built from endurance alone, but from a clearer relationship to capacity and consequence.
inner_life_restoration_structure.11: Inner life restoration becomes visible through friendship, community, networks, and the future the person is willing to join. Repair moves outward when belonging stops requiring self-erasure, and when the person can participate in collective life without confusing usefulness with worth.
inner_life_restoration_structure.12: Inner life restoration becomes visible through solitude, dreams, grief, spiritual practice, and the material that operates behind the visible self. The structure may be quiet, but not vague: rest, retreat, therapy, ritual, or release becomes the hidden support that changes everything else.
inner_life_restoration_structure.fallback: Inner life restoration becomes visible through the house where private repair has public consequence. The theme asks what must be soothed, protected, released, or rebuilt inside the person before their outer participation can stop repeating an old survival pattern.

resource_material_structure.3: Resource and material structure becomes visible through skills, information, transportation, neighbors, siblings, and local exchange. resource_material_structure.4: Resource and material structure becomes visible through home, property, land, family support, inheritance of habit, and the emotional cost of security. resource_material_structure.5: Resource and material structure becomes visible through creativity, pleasure, children, romance, performance, and chosen risk. resource_material_structure.6: Resource and material structure becomes visible through labor, health, routines, tools, service, and the systems that prevent waste. resource_material_structure.7: Resource and material structure becomes visible through contracts, clients, partners, negotiations, and the economics of equality. resource_material_structure.8: Resource and material structure becomes visible through shared money, debt, taxes, inheritance, intimacy, and the consequences of merging. resource_material_structure.9: Resource and material structure becomes visible through education, travel, law, publishing, spirituality, and long-range planning. resource_material_structure.10: Resource and material structure becomes visible through career, reputation, institutions, leadership, and the public measure of competence. resource_material_structure.11: Resource and material structure becomes visible through networks, audiences, communities, patrons, friends, and collective economies. resource_material_structure.12: Resource and material structure becomes visible through hidden costs, retreat, institutions, spiritual labor, grief, and work done outside ordinary recognition.
